author: phx reporter
title: Senator Mark Finchem shares thoughts on elections and upcoming interviews
text:
Senator Mark Finchem, a Republican elected in 2025 to represent Arizona’s 1st Senate District, has recently shared several posts on his social media platform addressing upcoming interviews and expressing opinions on Election Day outcomes and political accountability.
On November 4, 2025, Finchem announced an upcoming interview with Charles Hoskinson: “I am excited to have @IOHK_Charles on a future show. So much knowledge to share! @DigitalGoldTalk @Luckygroundrock https://t.co/4dikw0PwR0”.
The following day, November 5, he commented on election results by posting: “Election Day Winners and Losers, suicide by ballot box? https://t.co/ajiLV038KU”.
Shortly after, Finchem questioned the actions of public officials in another post: “WTH? You have to power to act on behalf of the people and nothing? #Impotent https://t.co/MJdQVPkBtJ”.
Finchem began serving as state senator for Arizona’s 1st Senate District in 2025 after succeeding Ken Bennett. His recent online statements reflect both his engagement with technology leaders and his critical perspective on political processes within the state legislature.
